item.title: Rallying Cry – August 17, 2026
item.description: From a sprinter’s record-breaking gold to a toddler safely rescued by a kind stranger, plus promising COVID vaccine benefits for brain cancer patients and a new documentary celebrating Mary Oliver’s poetry, today’s news is full of inspiration and hope.
